targetRepo.description: Absolute path to the freshly-cloned target repo the worker runs the full harness setup flow against. The orchestrator always supplies this (one detached worker per clone).

harnessSource.description: Where the harness product comes from. 'local' = install from the project root at $MINIH_PROJECT_ROOT (file install, fast, deterministic). 'github' = npm install github:AI-Substrate/harness-engineering (proves the npx-from-repo path). 'global' = already installed on this machine (CLI on PATH + skills available) — SKIP the install step and run the flow against the preinstalled product.

keepTarget.description: Leave the cloned target repo (with its written .harness/ artifacts) on disk for inspection instead of deleting it. The orchestrator owns clone lifecycle; the worker honours this only if it created throwaway scratch of its own.
